_comment: A lord's commission (docs/LIVING_WORLD_2.md §8): weight 0, so no board posts it; offered by rank in the lord's or steward's conversation and bound to the domain's real state by the 'commission' block (quest/commission/Binder).

objectives.label: Survey the Great Mine for his lordship

title: The Great Mine
Survey the deep workings
His lordship's mine
summary: The Great Mine of the domain lies {distance} {direction} of {settlement}. Go to its pithead and see how it stands.
His lordship wants a sworn man's eye on the Great Mine: its pithead, its men, its works.
Survey the Great Mine and tell his lordship what you find.
offer: The Great Mine is the domain's purse, and his lordship hears nothing from it but complaint. Go and see, {distance} {direction}.
Look at the Great Mine for me. The pithead, the hoist, the men. I want the truth.
Ride to the Great Mine, {direction} of here, and see whether it earns what it costs.
complete: So it stands. His lordship will be glad of a true account.
A clear report. That is worth more than a cart of ore.
Good. Now we know what the mine is worth.
